purpose: Generate controller-style command fetch/verify/acquire/execute with fixed MM2S/S2MM and Agent-generated compute extensions; native split bank ownership

fixed_architecture.command_source: PS writes a separate command BRAM through AXI BRAM Controller Port A
fixed_architecture.dispatcher_command_port: native synchronous BRAM Port B signals cmd_enb cmd_addrb cmd_doutb
fixed_architecture.bank_ownership: independent read/write module-port owners through bank_native_ownership; valid/role plus exact-edge accepted signals
fixed_architecture.issue_policy: strict current-PC; fetch then verify, acquire atomic operand banks before engine valid; advance PC only after engine handshake
fixed_architecture.outstanding_policy: multiple nonconflicting commands tracked per direction/bank; DMA waits both bank directions free
fixed_architecture.completion_policy: Engine issues completion resp_valid only after all required memory resp_valid responses are received and processed and final writes are accepted. Controller stores matched completion until matching-role release is accepted; no bank read-pending tracking.
fixed_architecture.terminal_policy: END drains tracked commands, buffered completions and both bank busy vectors before DONE.

parameter_legality: MAX_COMMANDS is at least 1 and no greater than 2^CMD_ADDR_WIDTH
CMD_DATA_WIDTH is at least OPCODE_WIDTH + 3*BANK_NUM_WIDTH + BANK_ADDR_WIDTH + BTT_WIDTH + AXI_ADDR_WIDTH
MM2S_BANK_MASK and S2MM_BANK_MASK name design-approved logical DMA banks

instruction_record.packing: contiguous from CMD_DATA_WIDTH-1 downward; any remaining least-significant bits are reserved

fixed_opcode_semantics.END: has no operand bank and begins drain without an executor request
fixed_opcode_semantics.MM2S: operand0_bank is destination data bank; AXI address is DDR source; tag is zero-extended operand0_bank
fixed_opcode_semantics.S2MM: operand0_bank is source data bank; AXI address is DDR destination; tag is zero-extended operand0_bank

fixed_legality: MM2S and S2MM require operand0_bank less than BANK_NUM
MM2S and S2MM require nonzero byte_count
MM2S/S2MM require the matching DMA capability mask bit to be set before any bank acquisition

extension_rules: Agents copy the template into a design revision and edit only between matching USER markers.
User executor operands are logical bank IDs and never local raw addresses.
Every user request valid is independent of executor ready and stable until acceptance.
All operand read/write banks are acquired atomically before the user engine request is asserted.
Each acquire identifies the executor's module-port role selected by operand position, not its opcode or whole-module identity.
Every acquired bank is released exactly once with the matching module-port role by completion or shared reset.
Extensions must add self-checking simulation and fresh synthesis evidence; template evidence does not transfer to generated modules.
USER decode/issue hooks describe wr/rd bank request masks and module-port roles. Acquire before user request valid; user engine valid held until ready even upon asynchronous error.
Generated completion hooks store command-specific bank/tag/role until release accepted, rely on engine completion after all read responses and writes, and expose user_pending_any.
Unknown/mismatched completions must not release ownership; physical transport recovery resets all affected modules.
Base names only MM2S/S2MM; arbitrary compute role IDs/opcodes are generated per design.

Memory resp_valid is a read response; engine completion resp_valid authorizes release only after all required read responses have been received and processed and all writes accepted. No requests for that command follow completion.

required_cases: command BRAM address zero is independent of data bank zero
data bank zero may be acquired released and reused
fixed DMA acquire and release carry the matching DMA module-port role
two MM2S commands to distinct banks issue before completion
MM2S and S2MM to distinct banks may both remain pending
same-bank command stalls without lookahead
valid and typed payload remain stable under ready backpressure
completion releases during later fetch or stall
spurious or mismatched status never releases a bank
END waits for pending entries and bank_busy to clear
missing END reaches bounded error
reset clears pending state and pulses
all required USER markers occur exactly once and in begin/end order
engine never issues before all directional bank acquires accepted
asynchronous response error during stalled engine valid preserves payload and valid
engine completion follows final read response and is retained until matching release accepted exactly once
bank+tag/role checks reject distinguishable stale/duplicate/outofrange completion; document bank-only tag reuse assumption
atomic multi-bank generated arbitrary-role extension with native bank children
END drains both owner directions and buffered completions; engines complete after all reads
reject acquire ack failure and require coordinated reset
native bank subsystem connected XPM payload MM2S-to-S2MM roundtrip
DMA capability masks reject unsupported bank with no acquisition or engine request

does_not_claim: AXI BRAM Controller instantiation or address assignment
user compute executor ports or behavior
board integration bitstream or physical-board validation

native_bank_contract.scope: Explicit opt-in replacement for common exclusive ownership at this template boundary; existing model revisions unchanged

behavior.acquire: DMA both directions free; atomic pulse only when eligible; sample accepted at same edge; no engine request until acquired; missing/partial ack faults and retains safely until reset
behavior.completion: DMA valid&&ready completed entry latch; use role constant from tracked DMA direction, not bank current owner; distinguishable duplicate/spurious/outofrange responses fault without releasing new owner; consume matching same-engine-handshake completion if allowed or explicitly fault+retain new outstanding Engine owns read completion qualification; controller has no bank read-pending input.
behavior.errors: sticky first code visible in any active state. Do not withdraw engine valid under stall on async error. Matching engine error completions retire/release after engine has received and processed all read responses and writes are accepted. Bank subsystem or acquisition/release ack protocol failure fail-stops with retained ownership requiring coordinated reset. No arbitrary release on invalid response.
behavior.reset: synchronous active-low reset clears tracking; controller and banks must reset together
behavior.instruction_layout: keep existing typed MM2S/S2MM AXI addr/BTT/offset/tag DataMover interface and existing command record; extension Agents decode model payload, no hardcoded RMSNorm/GEMV/weight-DMA
behavior.transport_assumption: DMA tags remain zeroextended bank IDs. Status delivery must be exactly once; a delayed old status after same bank/direction reissue with identical tag is not distinguishable without transaction generation bits. Reject duplicates while buffered/before reuse and mismatches; no universal post-reuse stale detection claim.
